_about: THE CLOSING LINE'S WORDS, written once (the owner, 24 October 2026, for the line at the foot of every bill card on a session day; moved here 5 November 2026 so the live session page says a day's votes in the same words). build_session_pages.py reads them through components.WORDBOOK, and the build writes them into site/components.js as WORDBOOK.closing. A key starting with '_' is a note and goes to neither.

sentences: each sentence one template with its places named ({chamber}, {verb}, {how} ...), filled by i18n.fill's rule. who, after, left: the words that fill a place and are themselves a choice of words. narrative_key: the history's own row of narrative.RECOMMENDATION for a motion the card reads. vote_said: a motion the history has no words for, in the plain words of its head's gloss. nuance_of: the history's two notes (narrative.NUANCE), by the motion. build_session_pages' THE CLOSING LINE says why each is as it is.

sentences.voted_third: The {chamber} voted to {verb}{how} and ordered it to a third reading.
sentences.rejected_third: The {chamber} rejected a motion to {verb}{how} and ordered it to a third reading.
sentences.rejected_short: The {chamber} rejected a motion to {verb}{how}, short of the {needed} majority it needed.
sentences.open: The {chamber} took up a motion to {verb}{how}; the record does not say whether it carried.
sentences.pending: The {chamber} adopted the motion that it ought to pass{amended}{how}{left}.
sentences.amd_adopted: {who}{num}{by} was adopted{how}, changing the text of the bill.
sentences.amd_open: {who}{num}{by} was taken up{how}; the record does not say how the vote went.
sentences.enrolled: An enrolled bill amendment{num} was adopted{how}, to correct technical errors found after passage.
sentences.overridden: The {chamber} voted{tally} to override the governor's veto{how}, meeting the two thirds threshold.
sentences.sustained: The {chamber} voted{tally} on overriding the governor's veto{how}, and the veto was sustained, failing to meet the two thirds threshold.
sentences.override_open: The {chamber} voted{tally} on overriding the governor's veto{how}; the record does not say the outcome.
sentences.quoted_open: The {chamber} took up “{words}”{how}; the record does not say how the vote went.
sentences.unnamed_adopted: The {chamber} voted on a question the record does not name{how}, and the motion carried.
sentences.unnamed_rejected: The {chamber} voted on a question the record does not name{how}, and the motion failed.
sentences.unnamed_open: The {chamber} voted on a question the record does not name{how}.
sentences.back: It goes back to the {origin}, which can accept or reject the {chamber}'s changes.
sentences.agreed: Both chambers have passed it in the same form, so it goes to {after}.
sentences.agreed_only: Both chambers have passed it in the same form.
sentences.second: It goes to the {chamber} {committee} committee, and the {chamber} votes on it again once that committee reports.
sentences.second_other: It goes to a second {chamber} committee, and the {chamber} votes on it again once that committee reports.
sentences.conference_asked: If the {other} agrees, a committee of conference from both chambers will try to settle the differences.
sentences.conference_on: A committee of conference from both chambers will try to settle the differences.
sentences.conference_report: Once both chambers adopt the report, it goes to {after}.
sentences.override_too: The {other} must also override the veto for the bill to become law.
sentences.no_law: The bill did not become law.

left.third: , but its third reading was left pending
left.finance: , but its referral to the Finance committee was left pending

vote_said.table_amendment: lay the amendment on the table
vote_said.table_motion: lay the motion on the table
vote_said.nonconcur_conference: reject the other chamber's changes and ask for a committee of conference
vote_said.request_conference: ask for a committee of conference
vote_said.accede: agree to a committee of conference
vote_said.conference_report: adopt the committee of conference's report
vote_said.special_order: take it up at a set time
vote_said.divide: divide the question and vote on its parts separately
vote_said.order_third_reading: order it to a third reading
vote_said.third_reading: pass it at its third reading
vote_said.uphold_ruling: uphold the ruling of the chair
vote_said.print_debate: print the debate in the permanent journal
